definition: Budget pressure or limited fiscal capacity that constrained compensation choices.
analytical_unit: deduplicated municipality × compensation cycle × compensation mechanism × side implementation event
caption: This map shows 619 distinct documented fiscal constraint implementation events across 395 municipalities in 33 states. Budget pressure or limited fiscal capacity that constrained compensation choices. The geography matters because it locates the process in the retained evidence. Darker areas contain more events, not more workers or larger wage effects, and the map is not a national prevalence estimate.
